title: KDM3B inhibitors disrupt the oncogenic activity of PAX3-FOXO1 in fusion-positive rhabdomyosarcoma.
authors: Kim, Yong Yean; Gryder, Berkley E; Sinniah, Ranuka; Peach, Megan L; Shern, Jack F; Abdelmaksoud, Abdalla; Pomella, Silvia; Woldemichael, Girma M; Stanton, Benjamin Z; Milewski, David; Barchi, Joseph J Jr; Schneekloth, John S Jr; Chari, Raj; Kowalczyk, Joshua T; Shenoy, Shilpa R; Evans, Jason R; Song, Young K; Wang, Chaoyu; Wen, Xinyu; Chou, Hsien-Chao; Gangalapudi, Vineela; Esposito, Dominic; Jones, Jane; Procter, Lauren; O'Neill, Maura; Jenkins, Lisa M; Tarasova, Nadya I; Wei, Jun S; McMahon, James B; O'Keefe, Barry R; Hawley, Robert G; Khan, Javed
one_liner_zh: 该文通过化合物筛选和对接分析发现KDM3B抑制剂可抑制PAX3-FOXO1转录活性，但核心是药物发现与肿瘤治疗，未聚焦TF-DNA结合机制或AI/物理模拟建模，仅涉及分子对接，与课题关联较弱。
abstract: Fusion-positive rhabdomyosarcoma (FP-RMS) is an aggressive pediatric sarcoma driven primarily by the PAX3-FOXO1 fusion oncogene, for which therapies targeting PAX3-FOXO1 are lacking. Here, we screen 62,643 compounds using an engineered cell line that monitors PAX3-FOXO1 transcriptional activity identifying a hitherto uncharacterized compound, P3FI-63. RNA-seq, ATAC-seq, and docking analyses implicate histone lysine demethylases (KDMs) as its targets. Enzymatic assays confirm the inhibition of multiple KDMs with the highest selectivity for KDM3B. Structural similarity search of P3FI-63 identifies P3FI-90 with improved solubility and potency. Biophysical binding of P3FI-90 to KDM3B is demonstrated using NMR and SPR. P3FI-90 suppresses the growth of FP-RMS in vitro and in vivo through downregulating PAX3-FOXO1 activity, and combined knockdown of KDM3B and KDM1A phenocopies P3FI-90 effects. Thus, we report KDM inhibitors P3FI-63 and P3FI-90 with the highest specificity for KDM3B. Their potent suppression of PAX3-FOXO1 activity indicates a possible therapeutic approach for FP-RMS and other transcriptionally addicted cancers.
abstract_zh: 融合阳性横纹肌肉瘤（FP-RMS）是一种侵袭性儿科肉瘤，主要由PAX3-FOXO1融合癌基因驱动，目前缺乏靶向PAX3-FOXO1的治疗方法。在此，我们利用一种监测PAX3-FOXO1转录活性的工程细胞系筛选了62,643种化合物，鉴定出一种此前未被表征的化合物P3FI-63。RNA-seq、ATAC-seq和对接分析提示组蛋白赖氨酸去甲基化酶（KDMs）为其靶点。酶学实验证实其对多种KDMs具有抑制作用，其中对KDM3B的选择性最高。通过P3FI-63的结构相似性搜索，我们发现了溶解性和效力均有所改善的P3FI-90。利用NMR和SPR证实了P3FI-90与KDM3B的生物物理结合。P3FI-90通过下调PAX3-FOXO1活性，在体外和体内抑制FP-RMS的生长，且KDM3B和KDM1A的联合敲低可模拟P3FI-90的效果。因此，我们报告了KDM抑制剂P3FI-63和P3FI-90，它们对KDM3B具有最高的特异性。它们对PAX3-FOXO1活性的强效抑制表明，这可能为FP-RMS及其他转录依赖性癌症提供一种潜在的治疗策略。
